name: Customer Service Recovery
description: A customer-facing delay or dissatisfaction event. The AI recommends a lightweight proactive recovery action (e.g., notification or small gesture). The human decides whether to approve the minimal action, pause to investigate, or escalate.

entity_patches._note: Elevated penalty exposure due to customer sensitivity flag (baseline 5.0 -> 7.0 per hour)

difficulty_notes: Low-cost proactive recovery is usually optimal. Over-intervention (escalation) inflates cost unnecessarily.
